data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for Koolbase BaaS providing auth, database, storage, realtime and OTA updates.
data.what_it_does: It offers a single initialize call to enable authentication (email, password, OAuth, MFA), remote config, feature flags, secure storage, SQL database access via Drift, and realtime messaging. The SDK also handles version enforcement, code‑push updates and analytics for Android and iOS apps.
use_when: You need a full‑stack backend‑as‑a‑service for mobile with auth, DB and OTA updates
You want a single Flutter package to cover auth, storage and realtime without wiring multiple services
avoid_when: You target Flutter Web or desktop platforms
You prefer a self‑hosted backend or need fine‑grained server control
strengths: Supports multiple auth methods including MFA and OAuth
Provides secure storage and Drift‑based SQL out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS only
Tied to Koolbase service, no open‑source backend
Large package size due to many features
data.setup_notes: Add the package, call Koolbase.initialize with your public key before runApp; configure native iOS/Android settings for Apple and Google sign‑in; no extra build_runner steps required.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need secure key‑value storage without the full BaaS features

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a pure local SQLite solution when you don’t need remote sync or backend services

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple, non‑secure key‑value storage on mobile
